subject: Engagement sprint map & success checks for OrionRetail pilot
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@orionretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement sprint map & success checks for OrionRetail pilot

Hi Tom — thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the pilot schedule and acceptance gates.

Call highlights (30 min):
- Goal: validate Redwood’s hosted inference for in-store receipt summarization and returns routing at 500 QPS peak.
- Primary success criteria: 90% top-1 routing accuracy on labeled test set; end-to-end 95th percentile inference latency < 120ms; no PII exfil during sample replay.
- Data: Orion will provide a 2-week anonymized receipts sample (100k rows) + schema.
- Stakeholders: Tom (Product), Priya (Data), security@orionretail for questionnaire.

Proposed pilot sprint map (4 weeks):
Week 0 (1 week): Kickoff, data handoff, environment access (Redwood hosted sandbox), security checklist.
Week 1–2 (2 weeks): Ingestion + validation, integration tests against sample set, baseline metric capture.
Week 3 (1 week): Optimization (batching, KV caching), acceptance run and readout.

Owner assignments (suggested):
- Redwood PM: Irene Choi — pilot timeline & communications
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter — integration & performance tuning
- Redwood Eval lead: Priyom Das — success criteria, metric collection, readout deck
- Orion: Tom Hayes & Priya Singh — data delivery, labeling clarifications, acceptance sign-off

Attachments: OrionPilot-MAP.xlsx (sprint calendar + owners), SLA-options.pdf (optional latency/uptime choices).

Immediate asks:
1) Can Orion confirm data delivery date (we penciled in Sep 15)?
2) Security team: please confirm the preferred contact for the SOC2 questionnaire and whether a scanned cert is available.
3) Internal: Ben/Priyom — can you review the attached MAP and flag any gaps by EOD Thursday?

I’ll queue a 30-min kickoff for the week starting Sep 14 pending data delivery confirmation.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we have a match on dates.

—
Irene Choi
Product Lead, Solutions
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@orionretail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@orionretail.com>, OrionRetail Security <security@orionretail.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement sprint map & success checks for OrionRetail pilot

Irene — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Quick responses inline: 

- Data delivery: we can provide the anonymized receipts export on Sep 16 (engineering wants one extra day to scrub internal IDs).
- Security: forwarding to our security mailbox (security@orionretail.com). Our security lead, Priya, will coordinate the questionnaire — I’ve cc’d her. We do have a basic SOC2 report we can share once the NDA is signed.
- Success criteria: the accuracy and latency targets look reasonable; I’ll confirm with my ML lead but early signal suggests feasible.

One ask from our side: during Week 1–2 we’d like a short daily status stand (15 minutes) during integration days — can your SE join?

Agree to the owner assignments. Please send a calendar invite for Sep 16 kickoff (morning PST preferred).

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Hayes
Director, Product
OrionRetail
+1 (646) 222-9987

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@orionretail.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement sprint map & success checks for OrionRetail pilot

Thanks Tom — Ben here. Happy to join 15-min daily alignment during Week 1–2; morning PST is fine. A few technical clarifications so we can pre-prepare: 

1) Sample format & schema: can you confirm whether receipts include line-level UPCs or only free-text descriptions? Line-level SKUs allow the model to leverage structured features and will reduce false-routing.
2) Traffic profile: the 500 QPS peak — is that bursty (sub-second spikes) or steady? If bursts, we should provision for higher concurrency in the sandbox to test tail latency.
3) Test harness: would Orion be able to run a small A/B harness to label routing correctness (we can provide a CSV template)? That will speed acceptance.

I’ll prepare two sandbox configurations: "baseline" and "optimized" with suggested batching and KV cache sizes. Also attaching a short checklist to the MAP for infra access (credentials, IP allowlist, sample replay window).

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (512) 555-0199

Attachment: OrionPilot-MAP.xlsx (updated with checklist)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@orionretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement sprint map & success checks for OrionRetail pilot

Perfect — thanks everyone.

Confirming next steps: 
- Orion will deliver anonymized sample on Sep 16 (Tom).
- Security will respond with SOC2 pointer / contact (Priya).
- Redwood SE (Ben) will run morning 15-min standups Mon–Fri during integration (Weeks 1–2) — calendar invites to follow.
- Priyom will own the acceptance deck and final readout (Week 4).

I’ve created the kickoff invite for Sep 16, 09:30–10:00 PST and attached the MAP and SLA options in the invite. If that time doesn’t work, let me know and I’ll move.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Irene Choi
Product Lead, Solutions
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
